data.name: Ivy
data.gender_notes: Ivy is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English ifig, 'ivy'. Its root is Old English ifig. A modern English given name. Ivy is a English name meaning “Ivy plant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ivy expresses “Ivy plant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ivy total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
